en: A commemorative postcard featuring a central oval portrait of an older uniformed man with medals, framed by a laurel wreath topped with a royal crown. To the left stands a woman in white with a blue shield bearing three yellow crowns, in front of the Swedish flag and beside a lion holding a small shield. To the right stands an armored youth holding a shield with a golden lion, in front of the Norwegian flag. Mountains, water and landscape form the background. Text in Swedish appears beneath the image and along the bottom edge.
